description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports Control Regulation on Payment Terms No. 07.08.2023
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the promulgation of new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act. It contains legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing import control regulations, specific HS code exemptions, and authorization for customs procedures. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is in the context of his legal authority to issue regulations rather than detailing his portfolio responsibilities or being primarily about personnel changes. The core content is regulatory in nature, focusing on import control measures and customs procedures.
